all_member_failure_open_siblings.note: The race: member 2 fails, the woken task raises it and records that decision. Before its completion is written, member 1 (the lower position) fails and every other member completes. History has no workflow-task boundary, so without the decision replay would see a fully settled group and raise member 1 by position. The recorded decision makes replay raise member 2, as the live task did.
